200.en: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
And for every nation is a [specified] term. So when their time has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].

201.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

202.en: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away.

203.en: So invoke Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.
Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allah dislike it.

204.en: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.
And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.
So that Allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.

205.en: Marked from your Lord. And Allah 's punishment is not from the wrongdoers [very] far.
Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
"There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

206.en: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.

207.en: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.
And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

208.en: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] 'Aad and Thamud.

g: so let them not ask Me to hasten
so let them not ask Me to hasten
208.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.

209.en: That is for what your hands have put forth [of evil] and because Allah is not ever unjust to His servants."
Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.
Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord.

210.en: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.
And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere.
And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.

211.en: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
And you see many of them hastening into sin and aggression and the devouring of [what is] unlawful. How wretched is what they have been doing.

212.en: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
And they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift which is given.

213.en: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.
And whoever turned away after that - they were the defiantly disobedient.
And the weighing [of deeds] that Day will be the truth. So those whose scales are heavy - it is they who will be the successful.

214.en: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
And your god is one God. There is no deity [worthy of worship] except Him, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

215.en: It is Allah who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat.
Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.

216.en: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].
O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allah while you witness [to their truth]?
And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?

217.en: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?

218.en: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."

219.en: And establish prayer and give zakah and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.
Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger Jesus, so register us among the witnesses [to truth]."
And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."

220.en: "That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire.
That is only Satan who frightens [you] of his supporters. So fear them not, but fear Me, if you are [indeed] believers.
That is Allah, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?

221.en: That is so al-'Azeez will know that I did not betray him in [his] absence and that Allah does not guide the plan of betrayers.
That is because they preferred the worldly life over the Hereafter and that Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.
Indeed, [O Muhammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allah guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

222.en: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.

223.en: And they attribute to Allah daughters - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire.
For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home.

224.en: Or [until] you have a garden of palm tress and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
Allah has prepared for them gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide eternally. That is the great attainment.

225.en: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me, I will guide you to the way of right conduct.
Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
[Noah] said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds."

226.en: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.
And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.

227.en: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"
And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day when the enemies of Allah will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven] assembled in rows,
And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.

228.en: Then, did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them at night while they were asleep?
Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.

g: and surely We (would have) admitted them
228.en: And if only the People of the Scripture had believed and feared Allah, We would have removed from them their misdeeds and admitted them to Gardens of Pleasure.

229.en: So when the Qur'an is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy.
So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].
And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."

230.en: But those who deny Our verses - the punishment will touch them for their defiant disobedience.
But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know.
And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.

231.en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]

232.en: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allah [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

233.en: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds.
And We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs,

234.en: And this [Qur'an] is a Book We have revealed [which is] blessed, so follow it and fear Allah that you may receive mercy.
O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.
So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

235.en: And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

g: will be allowed to make amends
235.en: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
[The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship

236.en: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
That Day, those who disbelieved and disobeyed the Messenger will wish they could be covered by the earth. And they will not conceal from Allah a [single] statement.
And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."

237.en: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?
Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?

238.en: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
But as for those whose faces will turn white, [they will be] within the mercy of Allah. They will abide therein eternally.
But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

239.en: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
And that was 'Aad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant.
And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

240.en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"

241.en: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
[The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.
And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.

242.en: And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers.
However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
So when there came to them the truth from Us, they said, "Indeed, this is obvious magic."

243.en: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."
And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.

244.en: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].

g: And surely, We will let them taste
244.en: And we will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will repent.
[It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.

245.en: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."
[It will be said], "Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant."
Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.

246.en: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."
And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
Then We will surely question those to whom [a message] was sent, and We will surely question the messengers.

247.en: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

248.en: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.

249.en: Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely.

g: surely He would have guided you
249.en: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely.
